name: Spiralkey Dragon - Adult
description: Adult Spiralkey is a neutral-leaning firmament intelligent true dragon with a floating wingless body traced with golden spirals. It seeks to find sealed paths and challenge those who force passage. At this age it is a commanding force in its territory.

attacks.name: Spiral Horns
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 3 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Floating
abilities.description: The dragon floats over ground hazards and ignores difficult ground.

abilities.name: Threshold Breath
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 19. On a failure, take 3d8+6 magic damage and the dragon moves the target to an unoccupied visible place within Close range. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Open a Way
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Create an opening between two visible unoccupied points within Far range. The dragon immediately moves between them without crossing the intervening space; the opening closes at the end of its next spotlight.

abilities.name: Wrong Door
abilities.description: When attacked by a creature within Close range, mark a Stress. After resolving the attack, move that attacker to another unoccupied visible space within Close range.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
